\begin{lemma}\label{train:base}
For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[x+x=2x.\]
\end{lemma}
\begin{theorem}\label{train:implicit}
For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[3x+x=4x.\]
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}The preceding lemma suggests the same collection of like terms.\end{proof}
